route.note: Without --full, /brag drops to brag-slim on Opus 5.5; the route check rejects that route.

contact_sheet.LEAD_ACTION: Download artifact film-preproduction-review from the Film toolchain run, review contact-sheet.png, set signoffs.contact_sheet.status to SIGNED_OFF and fill in the reviewer, before the /brag --full render.

animatic.LEAD_ACTION: Download artifact film-preproduction-review from the Film toolchain run, review animatic.mp4, set signoffs.animatic.status to SIGNED_OFF and fill in the reviewer, before the /brag --full render.

final_render_gate: The final-render job must run checkRenderLog (film/storyboard/preproduction.mjs) on this file and fail on any problem.

reference_clip.reason: The public worktree does not contain the private X reference-clip link, so the pre-production pass attempted the reference-clip step and recorded it as not viewed.
reference_clip.step: Open the X reference clip at the link held in the private program tracker and replace this record with viewed before the hook is locked for final render.
